A Synthetic Study of Point-to-Point Registration

Test Author
Abstract

A synthetic abstract for tests. arXiv:0000.00001v1

I Introduction

We estimate the robot pose by minimizing the point-to-point residual between consecutive scans. The data association uses a fixed threshold of 0.5 m and a robust kernel.

The state vector is x and gravity is 9.81 m/s^2.

r (1)

Each scan is deskewed with a constant velocity model before matching [1].

II Method

The robust kernel down-weights outliers in the residual. We compare against a baseline without the robust kernel. The covariance is propagated with a first-order Jacobian.

T (2)

The method runs at 10 Hz on a single CPU core.
